yamlCheck.dateAnchor: January 8 and the morning opening are independently spoken. The year 1749 and January 3 start come from YAML; January 3 is not independently established in this transcript.
yamlCheck.explanation: The episode resolves roughly two and a half days of Tollen business retrospectively, explicitly recalls an overnight coastal crossing, and plays the January 8 expedition. It does not establish the entire intervening journey or the exact beginning of the Tollen interval. The full five-boundary YAML span is therefore unverified, without an established contradiction. The missing interval has not been supplied from drEnd.
